import numpy as np
r2 = np.load('/work/fwd/r2/run.npz')

def entropy(row):
    row = row + 1e-10
    return -np.sum(row * np.log(row))

print("=== L0H0 Attention Patterns ===")
for inp, label in [(0, "1a@pos1"), (1, "1a@pos5"), (2, "2a"), (3, "3a"), (4, "0a")]:
    p = r2['L0H0_ATTN_pattern'][inp]
    avg_ent = np.mean([entropy(p[i]) for i in range(10)])
    max_w = np.max(p)
    max_pos = np.unravel_index(np.argmax(p), p.shape)
    col_avg = np.mean(p, axis=0)
    print(f"\n{label}: avg_entropy={avg_ent:.3f}, max_weight={max_w:.3f} at {max_pos}")
    print(f"  col means: {np.round(col_avg, 3)}")

print("\n=== L0H0 Write Position Invariance ===")
for inp, label in [(0,"1a@pos1"), (1,"1a@pos5"), (2,"2a"), (3,"3a"), (4,"0a")]:
    writes = r2['L0H0_ATTN'][inp]
    rng = np.max(np.abs(writes - writes.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)))
    print(f"{label}: max_deviation_from_mean = {rng:.6f}")

print("\n=== Uniform entropy reference: ", np.log(10), "===")

import numpy as np
r2 = np.load('/work/fwd/r2/run.npz')  # normal
r6 = np.load('/work/fwd/r6/run.npz')  # L0H0 ablated

print("=== L0_MLP write change when L0H0 ablated ===")
for inp, label in [(0,"1a@pos1"), (1,"1a@pos5"), (2,"2a"), (3,"3a"), (4,"0a")]:
    mlp_with = r2['L0_MLP'][inp]
    mlp_no   = r6['L0_MLP'][inp]
    base = np.linalg.norm(mlp_with)
    diff = np.linalg.norm(mlp_with - mlp_no)
    print(f"{label}: base_norm={base:.2f}, diff_norm={diff:.2f}, frac={diff/base:.4f}")

print("\n=== Does MLP write differ by token type (same count)? ===")
# Both inputs 0 and 1 have 1 'a', at pos1 vs pos5
# At pos3 (b in both), does MLP write differ?

    w0 = r2['L0_MLP'][0, pos, :]  # 1a@pos1
    w1 = r2['L0_MLP'][1, pos, :]  # 1a@pos5
    diff = np.linalg.norm(w0 - w1)
    print(f"  pos{pos}: diff between 1a@pos1 and 1a@pos5 = {diff:.6f}")
    print(f"    1a@pos1: {np.round(w0[:4], 3)}")
    print(f"    1a@pos5: {np.round(w1[:4], 3)}")
